title: Velocity at D
description: Essential: Correctly states or calculates the velocity at point D using the condition for just passing the top: v_D = sqrt(gR).

title: Work-Energy B to D
description: Important: Applies the work-energy theorem between points B and D, accounting for gravity and friction work.

title: Conveyor Belt Speed
description: Essential: Correctly solves for the conveyor belt speed v using kinematic relationships from A to B and the work-energy theorem on the belt.

title: Velocity at B
description: Important: Correctly determines the velocity at point B using projectile motion from A to B and the given geometry.

title: Velocity at A
description: Important: Correctly determines the velocity at point A using the projectile motion angle and the velocity at B.

title: Friction Work Sign
description: Pitfall: Incorrectly assigns the sign for the work done by friction (should be negative for work done *by* the block to overcome friction).

title: Energy Conservation Setup
description: Optional: Explicitly states conservation of energy principles or correctly sets up the work-energy equation for the belt segment.

title: Unit Consistency
description: Pitfall: Uses inconsistent units (e.g., mixing cm and m) or omits units in final answers.
